address: Level 7A, Four Seasons Hotel, 145 Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur, 50450, Malaysia
bio: Check out the spice table at the entrance for a preview of what's to come. Cosy and private, booth seats by the window command sweeping city views. Start with one of the magical concoctions mixed by the mixologists, followed by creative nomadic cuisine based on Southern Indian and Sri Lankan fare. The dinner set menu with 10-plus courses features different taste profiles and traditional snacks, best enjoyed with the alcoholic drink pairings....
